Title: The Snacking Habit That Might Be Backing You Up

Description:
Reaching for a bag of chips at your desk again? About 1 in 5 US adults deals with chronic constipation, and that everyday habit might be part of the problem.

Chips and processed snacks are stripped of fiber, cheese and dairy contain casein that digests slowly, and skipping water makes stool harder to pass. None of these need to be cut out completely - watch for simple swaps that can help.
